TIMEOUT=540
START=$(date +%s)
PREV_BC_COUNT=0
while true; do
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  ELAPSED=$((NOW - START))
  if [ $ELAPSED -ge $TIMEOUT ]; then
    echo "TIMEOUT after ${ELAPSED}s"
    break
  fi
  # Check breadcrumb ndjson for latest activity
  LATEST_BC=$(ls "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/run-step5-review."*".ndjson" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$LATEST_BC" ]; then
    BC_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$LATEST_BC" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$BC_COUNT" -ne "$PREV_BC_COUNT" ]; then
      tail -3 "$LATEST_BC" 2>/dev/null
      PREV_BC_COUNT=$BC_COUNT
    fi
  fi
  # Check done sentinel
  DONE_FILE=$(ls "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/run-step5-review."*".done."* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$DONE_FILE" ] && [ -s "$DONE_FILE" ]; then
    echo "REVIEW_DONE=true"
    cat "$DONE_FILE"
    break
  fi
  sleep 15
done
